title: Skill quality gate: anatomy lint, routing evals, installed-tree xref, generated runtime variants

AC1.note: Catalog entries are file-backed: description and triggers are read from the skill's own SKILL.md frontmatter, so a difference is impossible rather than merely tested (src/gdskills/catalog.ts; test 'catalog description equals SKILL.md frontmatter'). renderedSkill() now requires an explicit description. The 'Use when ${purpose}' fallback is gone from catalog.ts — the only two occurrences left in src/ are a comment recording that 67 of 78 entries once used it and a test named for its retirement.

AC2.note: description:trigger-phrase, description:bare-imperative and description:length in src/gdskills/bundled-eval.ts, each with a failing fixture and a passing control in bundled-eval.test.ts. Shipped tree: 'skills verify --bundled' exit 0 at 03c2d1c6 — zero description findings.

AC3.note: anatomy:sections checks the NOT-for clause, the Red Flags table and the Verification/exit-criteria section; exemptions are a reason-carrying map asserted non-empty with a reason per entry; fixtures cover each missing section separately. Shipped tree: zero findings (verify exit 0).

AC4.note: anatomy:length in bundled-eval.ts, guarded to canonical SKILL.md files. src/gdskills/skill-length-ceilings.ts carries 67 entries (values = the line count each skill measured when recorded) and DEFAULT_SKILL_LENGTH_CEILING = 500. A test asserts every recorded ceiling still EQUALS the current count, so a ceiling cannot be raised to pass a check and a trim must lower it in the same commit. skills-storage-workflow.mdc has a 'Length Ceilings' section quoting the finding message verbatim; a test reads both. Fixtures prove the over-ceiling and the over-default findings.

AC5.note: src/commands/routing-corpus.ts: 78 cases (every catalog entry, rendered included), 287 positives, 156 negatives — each negative names the skill that must outrank it. The test scores them through the shipped scoreBundledSkillRoute. The record is two integers, RANK1_FIRST = 285 and RANK1_TOTAL = 287, compared for equality against a live recount, so a regression and an unrecorded improvement both fail. Two known gaps are recorded with excluded: false — they count against the record.

AC6.note: description:collision at similarity >= 0.75 on routeTokens — the router's own tokenisation, now shared from src/lib/route-tokens.ts so the check cannot drift from the scorer. Fixtures prove the finding; shipped tree has zero (verify exit 0).

AC7.note: T12 resolved the collisions the corpus named: 'clarify requirements' -> interviewer, 'write tests'/'generate tests' -> test-gen, 'create tests first' -> tests-creator, 'review my code'/'full review' -> review-orchestrator, 'implement this issue' -> its named owner with the other two orchestrators as negatives, and 'check performance' — previously a three-way tie — resolved to one owner. Each is a corpus case, so the ranking is asserted continuously.

AC8.note: 58 SKILL.<runtime>.md files byte-identical to their SKILL.md were deleted; 15 remain and all genuinely differ — the 7 gproject planning skills x codex/cursor plus feature-analyzer/SKILL.detail.md. Install prunes stale per-runtime copies it finds in an already-installed tree (removeStaleRuntimeBuilds). export.ts no longer reports usedFallbackBuild; schemaVersion is 2, tied to that removal by a test. Build-parity, status-contract, round-bound, agent-catalogue-xref and bundled-eval pass with updated denominators (full suite 0 fail).

AC9.note: Red Flags + Verification backfilled across the quality (T13), platform/planning/orchestration (T14) and review (T15) skills, each row naming a failure specific to that skill; T19 added substance floors so an empty section or a copied table is a finding. No workflow skill needs an anatomy:sections exemption.

AC10.note: T16: the xref sweep covers companion documents including orchestrator-prompt.md, frontmatter is read through parseSkillFrontmatter, and the path pattern no longer captures a trailing sentence period. feature-dev, hookify and deploy no longer hardcode 'npx tsc'.

AC11.note: docs/skills/rejected-skill-changes.md exists with 4 entries, and skills-storage-workflow.mdc requires consulting it before proposing a skill change and appending on rejection. T19 added a contract test for the ledger. The instructed fix of adding docs/ to CHECKED_PATH_ROOTS was refused with measurement: 13 shipped paths name a user's own project, and docs/ is not in package.json files, so the check would fail for every installed user.

AC12.note: At 03c2d1c6 (rebased onto origin/main): rules mirror byte-identical (diff -rq clean), skills mirror differs only by rendered-only directories, 'skills verify --bundled' exit 0, tsc --noEmit exit 0, eslint clean, bun test 10065 pass / 20 skip / 0 fail across 751 files in 251s. The pre-change baseline in journal.md is 9772 pass / 0 fail; no failure absent from it.
